code/rust/core_contracts/src/certificate: Checked-packet sealing verifies schema/hash syntax, matching terminal/replay labels, None authority and a SHA256 of serde JSON material. Receipt-DAG verification consumes public count/flag assertions rather than traversing receipts; attestation checks distinct declared identity strings and a conditions boolean, not authenticated independence. Human-event validation checks text/hash bindings; actual Promote and host/human/epoch equality are enforced in promotion. Crucially the promotion capability has private fields, no public issuer, no Deserialize or Clone, so the ordinary safe-Rust promotion path is dormant. Authorized results have private fields and no Deserialize. Publisher renders a fixed eight-string JSON projection with explicit escaping and SHA256; self-digest establishes consistency, not authenticity. Tests internally construct the capability and cover valid promotion, missing DAG flag, identical identities, rejection/host mismatch, repeat publication, changed decision/scope, digest tampering and escaping. These are bounded contract tests, not live authenticated host activation or verification of arbitrary DAG facts.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_inta: Constructor is a declared parsing interface. ExactIntakeRatio implements checked i128 decimal accumulation to i64, one optional slash, nonzero denominator, checked positive-denominator normalization and unsigned-gcd reduction. It rejects booleans/decimal/scientific tokens, but accepts nonminimal integer text such as leading zeros and negative zero, normalizing the value. A denominator i64::MIN is refused before reduction even when the mathematical fraction could reduce into range. Tests cover reduction, zero and ordinary malformed tokens, not extreme bounds. This is a finite exact parser, not semantic admissibility.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_repr: Adapter/encoder/decoder/projector/reflector traits specify signatures without inverse, purity, idempotence or loss checks. ProjectorRank privately stores positive source rank and image rank <= source rank and computes their difference; tests cover 5-2 and image overflow. No linear map is supplied, so calling the difference kernel rank relies on an external rank-nullity premise and measured ranks.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_cand: Candidate and proposal traits carry declared law, evidence, loss, discarded-dimension and reflection metadata. EvidenceOnly is a default overrideable method, and no implementation is constrained to purity, determinism, monotonicity or truthful loss disclosure. The only executable local finite checks/tests are the exactly reconstructed capacity template. Interfaces are useful separation declarations but not admitted operator certificates.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_oper: Legacy operator interfaces label Lambda deterministic/stateless, Reducer idempotent/nonexpanding and Transform pure, but enforce only Rust signatures and caller-returned law metadata. LambdaWitness compares no Phi values; comparison enum and reference strings are public. Constructor/generator/adapter/codec interfaces likewise do not perform their documented semantic checks. Shared capacity code/tests are independent of these laws.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_anal: Analysis/diagnostic/functional/meta-judgment interfaces return public envelopes, defaulting to EvidenceOnly or RequestsDecision. IDs, subject hashes and certificate references are unvalidated wrappers. Forbidden-operation tokens appear only in comments here; traits do not prevent side effects, and envelope authority fields remain publicly mutable. Tests check constructor defaults, not functional purity or hash binding. The exact shared capacity template supplies no additional analysis guarantee.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_auth: Compatibility-only marker traits and empty assertion functions constrain associated marker types for candidate, engine, policy, witness, replay, terminalizer, public verification, math, adapter and packetization profiles. Required/Forbidden/Allowed are publicly implementable trait categories and attest no behavior. Thus compile-time marker agreement is not proof of determinism, nonmutation, totality, signing absence or lossless roundtrip. Shared capacity tests do not exercise these behavioral claims.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_stru: Carrier, quotient, observable, obstruction, tensor-shape and boundary traits declare interfaces and evidence references. Public reports default EvidenceOnly but have no validation or immutable authority field. QuotientProjection receives an arbitrary associated relation with no equivalence/congruence predicate, and the report does not itself prove a quotient. BoundarySpec lists crossings/predicates/required evidence without evaluating them. Tests check observation/obstruction constructor labels and generic capacity only.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_fixe: Five E/I/C/R/M labels and classifier signatures carry metadata rather than implementing algebra. ClassifiedAction::new rejects authority labels other than EvidenceOnly/RequestsDecision, but all fields are public and direct construction/mutation bypasses this convenience check. ClassificationResult convenience constructors and predicates check labels only; they do not verify the candidate's class or evidence. Tests cover those label gates plus shared capacity. No execution license is created by this file.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_exec: Runtime/pipeline/engine traits return state-output-trace triples and an engine accepts an unconstrained associated License type; no local license verification or execution algorithm exists. Kernel and health interfaces declare semantic families and reporting responsibilities. HealthReport constructor defaults EvidenceOnly but public fields are mutable and references/hashes unchecked. Tests cover that default and shared capacity, not health correctness or authority enforcement.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_gove: Auth, evaluator, terminal mapper and validator are caller-implemented interfaces. Public evaluation/terminal/validation records have unchecked strings, statuses and authority labels. TerminalMapper defaults RequestsDecision and Validator EvidenceOnly, both overrideable; there is no concrete authentication, policy predicate or structural validator in this file. The test's toy mapper emits VerifiedComplete with empty decision/certificate references and verifies only the RequestsDecision label. This supports interface separation, not truth of the terminal claim.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/witness_dir: WitnessDirective requests generation/properties through flags; comments correctly distinguish requests from verified evidence. DirectiveFlags checks duplicate property names and exact presence equivalence for eight known requirement flags, counting enabled flags with checked arithmetic. Other names are explicitly permitted and uncounted, and generation flags are not cross-validated here. Tests cover required names plus one unrelated basis property and a missing required name; no property-based witness execution occurs in this module.
code/rust/core_contracts/src/traits_evid: Evidence/certificate/replay/observable/witness interfaces and envelopes mainly store caller assertions. Raw MeasurementEnvelope uniquely hides its EvidenceOnly authority label and documents unvalidated values/references; payload fields remain mutable, and MeasurementValue admits zero denominators/nonfinite or inverted intervals. VerifiedCertificateClaim::new compares numeric ranks of two supplied authority labels without verification and public fields bypass the constructor; this is not the opaque host promotion capability. Most other envelopes have mutable public labels. Tests verify defaults, preservation of raw metadata and rank-bound rejection; doctests describe private measurement-field refusal. Shared capacity checks are unrelated to evidence truth.
